Stoneware Pour-Over Coffee Dripper

About this dripper

Our #1 best-selling stoneware pour-over coffee dripper is hand-glazed and kiln-fired for even heat retention. Compatible with Hario V60 02 paper filters. Brews one to two cups of clean, bright coffee in about three minutes. The thick stoneware walls hold temperature through the whole brew so your extraction stays consistent from bloom to final pour. Spiral ribs on the inside wall let air escape and keep the filter from sticking, while the single wide outlet lets you control flow with your pour speed.

Each dripper is shaped by hand, so small variations in glaze are part of its character. The base ring sits securely on most mugs and carafes up to 10 cm wide. Rinse with warm water after use; dishwasher safe on the top rack. Not suitable for stovetop or microwave use.
